interpretation: The operator's pin and the Census Bureau's interpolated position for 807 East 16th Street lie 38.8 m apart and fall in the same small 2020 census block (470650020001000, 1.07 ha of land) in Chattanooga city, Hamilton County; the matched TIGER segment carries the 801 to 899 range of East 16th Street. The selected point is the operator's facility reference point, confirmed to the correct street segment, block, place and county.
datum_note: The operator publishes no datum; the Census Geocoder returns NAD83 coordinates, which differ from WGS 84 by about 1 m here.
geocoder_role: U.S. Census Bureau Geocoder used only as an official cross-check of the published street address; its interpolated point is not the selected locator.
alternatives_rejected: Hamilton County is not in the Tennessee statewide parcel layer (us-nc-sc-tn-p5); mapsdev.hamiltontn.gov returned HTTP 404 for its service directory in that pass and gis.chattanooga.gov did not respond.

The City of Chattanooga GIS organisation's 'Hamilton County Address Parcel Layer' is hosted on services2.arcgis.com, whose robots.txt returns HTTP 403 (treated as a disallow), so it was not requested.
No OpenStreetMap, Nominatim, map-app, city centroid or county centroid was used.
